services.name: Private Charters
services.desc: Take your special event farther… aboard the most photographed boat in the entire Tampa Bay Region, SUNCOAST HORIZON. With cushioned seating and catering available, your special event will be the most memorable under sail. Suncoast Horizon can comfortably accommodate up to 25 passengers and is perfect for weddings, bachelor & bachelorette parties, birthdays, anniversaries, company parties and outings. Designed by the famous marine architect, Merritt Walter and built in Old Town, Florida, in 2000, Suncoast Horizon is a working replica of the schooners of old with the modern comforts of today. quotes.author: Brittany Clone
quotes.text: Captain Mike and crew were attentive and engaging from the moment we stepped into the Boatega. Prices even in store were very reasonable. The cruise was truly an unforgettable experience. I especially enjoyed the relaxed atmosphere. Their BYOB policy is generous and they even had freebies in the cooler from prior charters. Wonderful staff that was friendly, engaging, and attentive as needed. Highly recommend and will definitely take a tour again. 💗

quotes.author: Courtney Parker
quotes.text: Unforgettable Sunset Sail! I had an absolutely amazing time on this sunset sail! The weather was perfect, with calm seas and a stunning sky as the sun went down. The boat itself was gorgeous—clean, comfortable, and clearly well cared for. The crew made the experience even better—they were fun, friendly, and made everyone feel welcome and relaxed. It was the perfect way to end the day. Highly recommend!

quotes.author: Liz McBride-Gould
quotes.text: Local Gem … I had some girlfriends in town from California. I wanted to find a special event. This was perfect. We sailed out to the Gulf, floated and enjoy the sunset. We saw dolphins and the pirate ship and even got into a battle with the pirate ship. So much fun. We were able to bring our own snacks which was wonderful. The crew was so friendly. I highly recommend this trip.

quotes.author: Mary Dorta
quotes.text: We had an incredible experience sailing with Captain Mike and his mate! Their professionalism and enthusiasm made the day unforgettable. The scenery was breathtaking, and it truly felt like a little slice of paradise on the water. I can’t wait to do it all over again! Highly recommend! 🌊⛵️

quotes.author: Chris Dodge
quotes.text: What a beautiful day! A nice leisurely sail into the Gulf...was very relaxing and the crew was very nice. It was cook they had to open the ST Johns Pass drawbridge for us ;-)

quotes.author: eva spera
quotes.text: A fabulous intro sailing journey. The nicest folks and crew. Came down from Vermont to try with grandma. It was breathtaking....A MUST !!!
